text:
olivia: Quickstart hiccup: followed the Docker sample, curl to /v1/generate -> 200 but our app (Go SDK) immediately retries and then fails with 402 PaymentRequired. Console shows billing on the org. anyone seen this specific sequence?

onboarding-bot: Welcome! Workspace 'dev-olive' created. Reminder: attach billing to workspace if org settings require explicit linkage.

harry: Can you paste the container logs and env? Most common causes are env var mismatches or workspace override.

olivia: container env: REDWOOD_API_KEY is set, but sample also had REDWOOD_WORKSPACE=dev-olive baked in. logs: `auth: token ok`, then `retrying request (auth/billing): 500ms`, repeated, then `PaymentRequired workspace_unlinked`.

sdk-bot: Note: Gateway may return 402 when the call is scoped to a workspace without billing. If the client sends X-Redwood-Workspace header it will override org-scoped billing.

harry: That sequence means the SDK authenticated fine but the request was routed to a workspace lacking billing. Curl from host probably used a different workspace (no override) so it succeeded.

olivia: Oh! The sample's docker-compose had REDWOOD_WORKSPACE env to demo multi-workspace samples. I didn't expect it to be unpaid.

ci-bot: FYI: the sample CI uses a workspace id for integration tests; maintainers must ensure that workspace has billing attached.

docs: Two fixes: (1) update quickstart to avoid baking a workspace override into runnable examples, (2) SDK should include workspace id in 402 error text, so it reads e.g. `402 PaymentRequired (workspace dev-olive)` rather than generic.

harry: Also request: client should fail fast at startup if required envs are missing or if workspace override is detected and that workspace appears unbilled (we can do a cheap head call). Avoid long retry loops on auth/billing failures.

olivia: Workaround: unset REDWOOD_WORKSPACE and restarted container -> first call succeeded. Then I attached billing to dev-olive in console and re-set REDWOOD_WORKSPACE -> success again.

sdk-bot: Logged RED-9001: "quickstart: avoid default REDWOOD_WORKSPACE in samples; SDK to surface workspace id on billing errors; client to fail fast on missing/invalid key or unbilled workspace."

docs: I'll add a quick troubleshooting checklist to the onboarding guide: check REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY, verify REDWOOD_WORKSPACE, and how to check workspace billing in console.

olivia: First successful SDK call now. Leaving thread for the onboarding playbook. :tada:
